player/index.html.33: Enter your dorm in game first, then pick the same room and decoration template here. Finished pieces already in that room and in your furniture bag are deducted, then the missing blueprints are calculated. Only blueprints are purchased - furniture is never moved, recycled or crafted.

player/index.html.40: Only Furniture Coins are used - never Rainbow or Black Cards. Blueprints you already own are not bought again; if any blueprint is unbuyable or the balance is short, the whole order is skipped. Nothing is charged until you confirm the preview.
player/index.html.43: After purchasing, reopen the one-click furniture synthesis page in game.
player/index.html.45: Purple Co-op Merits belong to the shared guild pool; blue Joint Points belong to your own inventory, and they are topped up separately. Only the Commander and Vice Commander can move pool resources or upgrade; regular members can top up their own Joint Points. Enter the game first.
player/index.html.52: Spend stored EXP to level up once
player/index.html.53: Top-ups range 1-10,000 each and share a 10-second bureau cooldown. EXP does not auto-level: once you have enough, either pick "Spend stored EXP to level up once" or use Guild > Info > Manage > Upgrade in game. Guild level-ups award Beacon Boost Points; at max level every 32,000 EXP converts to 20 points.
player/index.html.58: Exit the game first, then preview and confirm. Cleanup deletes items outright with no material refund; items that are equipped, locked, or referenced by team presets and Memory sets are kept.
